versions.content: Successfully completed secure coding procedure If all the called write operations from [SWS_Dcm_01691] have been completed successfully, the Dcm shall set the positive response routine parameter DcmDspStartRoutine- OutSignal of the DcmSecureCodingValidationRoutine to the value of 0x00 to indicate a successful completion of the secure coding procedure and send a positive response for the DcmSecureCodingValidationRoutine .
